source.note: On the socks (the club's 2026 line-up says 'samt Coop på strømpene'); the kit schema has no socks placement, so it is filed as a kit partner.

source.name: Bodø/Glimt - Årets drakt: En drakt til folket (home kit launch, 19 Mar 2026)
source.quote: Glimts hjemmedrakt i 2026 er designet av Puma og er laget av 95 prosent RE:fibre-materiale

summary: Puma home shirt: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge on the chest, Stingray at the neck, Elkem on the shoulders, Altibox (Eliteserien's league partner) on the right arm, LNS on the left arm, The Quartz Corp on the upper back, Coop Nordland on the socks, and Novo Nordisk on the shorts from September 2026. Complete: the club's 9 March 2026 line-up names every shirt placement (the shorts were then free), and the Novo Nordisk announcement fills the shorts.
